messages.\n\nLas imágenes analizadas se incluyen: Analyzed images are included in the notification; the complete original email is attached.
messages.\n\nPrueba manual del correo de salida d: Manual test of PiVigia outgoing email.
messages.\nHay cambios guardados pendientes de re: Saved changes are waiting for a service restart.
messages.Después del reinicio, abre el panel en: After restarting, open the panel on port {port}.
messages.0.0.0.0 escucha en todas las interfaces: 0.0.0.0 listens on all network interfaces. This is not a domain name.
messages.0.0.0.0 permite recibir fotos desde otro: 0.0.0.0 allows photos to be received from other devices on the network.
messages.452 Un único buzón por mensaje; envía un: 452 Only one mailbox per message; send a copy to each mailbox
messages.454 Demasiados intentos de autenticación: 454 Too many authentication attempts; try again later
messages.Activa otro modelo antes de eliminar est: Activate another model before deleting this one.
messages.Alto máximo aceptado. Las imágenes demas: Maximum accepted height. Oversized images are skipped before analysis.
messages.Analizando la imagen en PiVigia… No se e: Analyzing the image in PiVigia… No notifications will be sent.
messages.Ancho máximo aceptado. El límite adicion: Maximum accepted width. The additional safety limit is 16 megapixels per image.
messages.Aviso por ausencia de las categorías sel: Notification because the selected categories are absent.
messages.Busca Red. Cambia el puerto de acceso as: Find Network. Change the access port mapped to 8099/tcp for the panel or 2525/tcp for cameras.
messages.Cada buzón es una dirección de entrada d: Each mailbox is an incoming address within PiVigia, for example patio@pivigia.local; you do not need to buy a domain. The camera sends to PiVigia's IP and incoming SMTP port (initially 2525). Use the mailbox address as both username and recipient. Alert recipients go in “Forward to”.
messages.Cambiar el idioma recarga el panel. Hay: Changing language reloads the panel. You have unsaved changes. Discard them?
messages.Cancela la descarga y espera a que termi: Cancel the download and wait for it to finish before deleting.
messages.Cola llena; el aviso se intentará en el: Queue full; the notification will be retried on the next analysis
messages.Comprueba tus imágenes y elige el detect: Check your images and choose the right detector.
messages.Conexión y análisis activos según los in: Connection and analysis active at configured intervals. Preview updated every 2 seconds.
messages.Configura admin_token con al menos 16 ca: Set admin_token to at least 16 characters in the add-on options
messages.Configura el servidor SMTP de salida y e: Configure the outgoing SMTP server and sender
messages.Configura tanto el certificado como su c: Configure both the certificate and its key
Keep the 0.0.0.0 listening addresses to accept connections from your network. 127.0.0.1 only accepts connections from the same device. The token is still required to administer PiVigia. Fields controlled by environment variables are locked.
messages.Contraseña del proveedor o contraseña de: Provider password or app password. Asterisks keep the saved password.
messages.Contraseña que pondrás en la cámara. Los: Password to enter on the camera. Asterisks keep the existing password.
messages.Correo de salida · quién enviará las ale: Outgoing email · who sends the alerts
messages.Correo rechazado: demasiadas partes MIME: Email rejected: too many MIME parts.
messages.Correos pendientes: análisis en vivo en: Emails pending: live analysis is waiting. The preview keeps updating.
messages.Crea un bot con @BotFather, guarda su to: Create a bot with @BotFather, save its token and send it /start from Telegram. Then click “Find recent chats” and copy the ID into the mailboxes you want to notify. For a group, add the bot and send /start in that group. For a channel, allow the bot to publish.
messages.Crea un buzón y conecta tu cámara. Aquí: Create a mailbox and connect your camera. Each analysis and its notification status will appear here.
messages.DETECCIÓN LOCAL · UN ANÁLISIS A LA VEZ: LOCAL DETECTION · ONE ANALYSIS AT A TIME
messages.Debe coincidir con el puerto. Sin cifrad: Must match the port. Unencrypted connections are only for a trusted local relay.
messages.Define qué detectar y quién recibe cada: Choose what to detect and who receives each notification.
messages.Descarga cancelada. Puedes iniciarla de: Download cancelled. You can start it again.
Download the model before activating it.
Download the model before testing it.
Download the model before using it.
messages.Descarga los modelos que quieras compara: Download the models you want to compare.
messages.Descarga verificada. Consulta la tarjeta: Download verified. Check the card to see whether the model is active.
messages.Descargando; puedes seguir usando el pan: Downloading; you can keep using the panel.
Downloading does not activate the model.
messages.Después de guardar, abre Pruebas para en: After saving, open Tests to send an email to a recipient of your choice.
messages.Detección inteligente en tu equipo. Las: Intelligent detection on your own device. Your camera images become notifications that matter.
messages.Detector no disponible. Comprueba el mod: Detector unavailable. Check the model and service log.
messages.Direcciones reales que recibirán alertas: Actual addresses that receive alerts; separate multiple addresses with commas. Leave empty to use Telegram only.
messages.Dirección remitente permitida por ese se: Sender address allowed by that server. This is not the virtual incoming mailbox address.
messages.Días de historial y eventos. Los trabajo: Days of history and events. Pending jobs are kept; failed jobs do expire.
messages.Ejemplo: 192.0.2.50/32. Varias IP o rede: Example: 192.0.2.50/32. Multiple IPs or networks separated by commas; leave empty to require authentication.
messages.Ejemplo: patio@pivigia.local. La cámara: Example: patio@pivigia.local. The camera uses this address as both username and recipient.
messages.El ajuste {key} está fijado por {variabl: Setting {key} is controlled by {variable}. Change that variable.
messages.El archivo o la petición supera el tamañ: The file or request exceeds the size limit
messages.El archivo supera el tamaño máximo guard: The file exceeds the saved size limit. Use another image or check the limits in Settings.
messages.El asunto no admite saltos de línea: The subject cannot contain line breaks
messages.El bot tiene un webhook u otra consulta: The bot has a webhook or another active query; use a dedicated bot
messages.El buzón de avisos de la cámara no exist: The camera's notification mailbox does not exist
messages.El buzón debe estar activo y tener Perso: The mailbox must be enabled with People selected. Its limits, confidence and destinations apply to the notification. The URL is stored in the service's private data.
messages.El buzón está desactivado: no enviaría a: The mailbox is disabled: it would not send notifications.
messages.El buzón seleccionado no existe. Actuali: The selected mailbox does not exist. Refresh the page.
messages.El buzón seleccionado ya no existe. Actu: The selected mailbox no longer exists. Refresh the page.
messages.El correo es el modo principal. Las cáma: Email is the primary mode. RTSP cameras are optional and can remain disabled.
messages.El correo sigue siendo la función princi: Email remains the primary function. Enable RTSP only if you need stream analysis. The preview uses updated images, without audio or video recording. Motion and people are detected.
messages.El modelo ligero está incluido en la apl: The lightweight model is included in the application and kept for recovery.
messages.El modelo ligero se instala al construir: The lightweight model is installed when PiVigia is built.
messages.El mínimo debe ser menor o igual que el: The minimum must be less than or equal to the maximum
messages.El panel y SMTP necesitan puertos difere: The panel and SMTP need different ports
The SMTP server accepted the email. Check your inbox and spam; this confirmation does not guarantee delivery to your inbox.
messages.El servidor SMTP rechazó el destinatario: The SMTP server rejected the recipient.
messages.El servidor SMTP rechazó las credenciale: The SMTP server rejected the credentials.
messages.El servidor rechazó el destinatario de p: The server rejected the test recipient.
messages.El servidor rechazó las credenciales. Re: The server rejected the credentials. Check the SMTP username and password.
messages.El token de administración debe tener al: The administration token must have at least 16 characters
messages.El token se configura en las opciones de: The token is set in the add-on options; for direct installations it is in data/admin-token.
messages.Elige cómo entrar. Desde Home Assistant: Choose how to sign in. From Home Assistant, use your session and its permissions; direct access uses the token if enabled.
messages.Elige un método de acceso válido: both,: Choose a valid sign-in method: both, homeassistant or token
messages.Elige una foto de tu equipo para ver qué: Choose a photo from your device to see what PiVigia detects. Processing is local: this test sends no email or Telegram notifications and does not save the image.
messages.En .env configura PIVIGIA_WEB_HOST_PORT: In .env, set PIVIGIA_WEB_HOST_PORT for the panel and PIVIGIA_SMTP_HOST_PORT for camera input. Then run docker compose up -d --build to recreate the container. Example: 8100 for the panel and 2526 for SMTP.
messages.En Home Assistant abre Ajustes → Aplicac: In Home Assistant, open Settings → Apps or Add-ons → PiVigia → Configuration.
messages.En Home Assistant elige el método de acc: In Home Assistant, choose the login method in the add-on Configuration and restart it: both allows Home Assistant sessions and tokens; homeassistant only allows sessions in the panel; token requires the token. In homeassistant mode, the token only retains status access for sensors.
messages.En Home Assistant usa Configuración y Re: In Home Assistant, use the add-on Configuration and Network settings; in Docker, change .env and the Compose ports, then recreate the container.
messages.En Servidor y puertos puedes consultar c: In Server and ports, see how to receive photos and where to change ports, STARTTLS and allowed IPs. In Home Assistant, change these in the add-on Configuration and Network settings, then restart.
messages.En una Raspberry Pi 4, empieza probando: On a Raspberry Pi 4, start by testing a photo. Larger models use more memory and take longer; cameras share the detector and may have to wait. A larger model does not guarantee detection in a difficult scene. Only the model is downloaded: your photos are analyzed locally.
messages.En una recepción normal, este buzón inte: On normal reception, this mailbox would attempt to notify via {channels}. This test did not send it.
messages.Entrada de 640 px. Más trabajo que Mobil: 640 px input. More demanding than MobileNet; compare the results with your photos.
messages.Entrar con mi sesión de Home Assistant: Sign in with my Home Assistant session
messages.Enviando el correo con los ajustes guard: Sending email with the saved settings… Do not close this tab.
messages.Espera entre eventos del mismo tipo y av: Delay between events of the same type and person notifications; prevents an alert for every frame.
messages.Este es un correo de prueba enviado desd: This is a test email sent from the PiVigia panel.
messages.Este token solo permite consultar el sen: This token only allows access to the status sensor.
messages.Estos son los datos de tu proveedor de c: These are your email provider or SMTP relay details. Do not enter PiVigia's IP here unless an outgoing relay runs on that device.
messages.Estás accediendo al panel desde {origin}: You are accessing the panel from {origin}.
messages.Guarda buzones, reglas y notificaciones: Save mailboxes, rules and notifications before running a test.
messages.Guarda los cambios y reinicia el servici: Save changes and restart the PiVigia service to apply them. The panel keeps running at its current address until the restart.
messages.Guarda primero el servidor SMTP de salid: First save the outgoing SMTP server and sender in Settings.
messages.Guarda primero los ajustes de correo en: First save email settings in Settings. SMTP server acceptance does not guarantee inbox delivery; also check spam. This test does not check SMTP reception from the camera.
messages.Guarda y reinicia PiVigia. Abre el panel: Save and restart PiVigia. Open the panel using Open Web UI and update the SMTP port on your cameras if you changed it.
messages.Guardado. Reinicia PiVigia para aplicar: Saved. Restart PiVigia to apply server changes.
messages.Guardar servidor para el próximo reinici: Save server settings for next restart
messages.Has salido del panel. Tu sesión de Home: You have left the panel. Your Home Assistant session is still active; you can sign out from Home Assistant.
messages.Hasta 8 cámaras configurables. Empieza c: Up to 8 configurable cameras. Start with one camera and its low-resolution secondary stream. Emails take priority over live analysis. Save to apply changes.
messages.Home Assistant (token solo para el senso: Home Assistant (token for status sensor only)
messages.IDs de conversaciones o grupos, separado: Conversation or group IDs, separated by commas. Find IDs using the Telegram button.
messages.Imagen demasiado grande para la notifica: Image too large for the notification
messages.Incluido con PiVigia. Menor consumo; se: Included with PiVigia. Uses fewer resources; kept as a recovery alternative.
messages.Indica el token del bot antes de activar: Enter the bot token before enabling Telegram
messages.Indica un destinatario válido, un asunto: Enter a valid recipient, a subject without line breaks and a message of up to 5000 characters.
messages.Inicia sesión con un token válido o abre: Sign in with a valid token or open PiVigia from Home Assistant with a Supervisor that forwards user groups.
messages.Inicial: 2525. Debe coincidir con el pue: Initial value: 2525. Must match the port entered on your cameras.
messages.Inicial: 8099. Al cambiarlo tendrás que: Initial value: 8099. After changing it, open the new address following a restart.
messages.La sesión ya no es válida. Vuelve a entr: Your session is no longer valid. Sign in again.
messages.Las IP permitidas, la autenticación sin: Allowed IPs, unencrypted authentication and certificates are configured in the add-on options, on the same Configuration tab.
messages.Las fotos se analizan localmente. Aquí a: Photos are analyzed locally. Detections, skipped messages and delivery errors appear here.
messages.Las reglas coinciden, pero el buzón no t: The rules match, but the mailbox has no active email or Telegram destinations.
messages.Las reglas de este buzón filtrarían esta: This mailbox's rules would filter this image.
messages.Los administradores de Home Assistant pu: Home Assistant administrators can configure and run tests. Regular and read-only users can view activity and cameras. Permissions are also enforced on the server. Identity must arrive through Ingress from Supervisor.
messages.Los análisis y avisos aparecerán aquí cu: Analyses and notifications will appear here when camera emails arrive.
messages.Los límites se aplican antes de analizar: Limits apply before analysis. Initial settings support 352 × 240 images. The model recognizes people, cars and six animal types: birds, cats, dogs, cows, horses and sheep.
messages.Los modelos descargados se conservan al: Downloaded models are kept during updates. You can delete and download them again. Activate another model before deleting the active one. MobileNet is included in the application and kept as a fallback.
messages.Los nombres como pivigia.local solo func: Names such as pivigia.local only work on devices that can resolve them. The local IP is the most direct option for a camera.
messages.Los puertos internos 8099 y 2525 se mant: Internal ports 8099 and 2525 stay unchanged: Supervisor maps them to your chosen access ports. The panel cannot change Home Assistant networking.
messages.Los puertos internos siguen siendo 8099: Internal ports remain 8099 and 2525. Allowed IPs and STARTTLS use the .env variables shown in .env.example.
messages.Los registros, correos, Telegram e imáge: Logs, emails, Telegram and annotated images will use this language. Save to apply it.
messages.Mayor consumo de RAM y CPU. Preferible p: Higher RAM and CPU usage. Test with photos first, rather than multiple streams.
messages.Modelo desconocido. Elige uno del catálo: Unknown model. Choose one from the catalog.
messages.Modelo usado: {model}. Tiempo de análisi: Model used: {model}. Analysis time (including waiting): {seconds} s.
messages.Máximo de imágenes que se analizan por c: Maximum images analyzed per email; the rest are skipped.
messages.Máximo de mensajes pendientes o fallidos: Maximum pending or failed messages with retained content. A full queue temporarily rejects new messages.
messages.No hay chats recientes. Guarda el token,: No recent chats. Save the token, send /start to the bot and search again.
messages.No hay espacio suficiente para descargar: Not enough space to download the model.
messages.No se ha podido completar la operación: The operation could not be completed
messages.No se ha recibido respuesta a tiempo. Co: No response was received in time. Check the connection; if this was a test email, check your inbox before retrying.
messages.No se han encontrado personas, coches o: No people, cars or animals found above the minimum confidence.
messages.No se pudo analizar la imagen. Comprueba: Could not analyze the image. Check that the file is valid.
messages.No se pudo cargar el modelo. La selecció: Could not load the model. The previous selection has been kept.
messages.No se pudo completar la entrega. Revisa: Delivery could not be completed. Check the settings and connection.
messages.No se pudo descargar y verificar. Compru: Could not download and verify. Check your Internet connection and free space; you can retry.
messages.No se pudo enviar. Revisa el servidor SM: Could not send. Check the outgoing SMTP server, port, security, sender and connection.
messages.No se pudo establecer una conexión TLS s: A secure TLS connection could not be established.
messages.No se pudo procesar el correo. Revisa la: The email could not be processed. Check the settings and models.
messages.No se pudo verificar la conexión TLS. Re: Could not verify the TLS connection. Check the server, port and security settings.
messages.No se puede conectar con Telegram o su r: Cannot connect to Telegram or its response is invalid
messages.No se puede consultar el acceso de PiVig: Cannot check PiVigia login options. Reload the page and check the service.
messages.Nombre del proveedor o relé, sin http://: Provider or relay hostname, without http://. Example: smtp.yourprovider.com.
messages.Normalmente 587 con STARTTLS o 465 con T: Usually 587 with STARTTLS or 465 with direct TLS. Use your provider's specified port.
messages.Opción experimental y lenta en Raspberry: Experimental and slow on Raspberry Pi. A larger model does not guarantee better detection.
messages.Para Gmail utiliza el servidor y las cre: For Gmail, use the server and credentials allowed by your account (for example, an app password). The sender must be authorized on that server. Notifications show annotated images and percentages; the complete original email is attached.
messages.Para invertir la detección, selecciona a: To invert detection, select at least one category and disable forwarding all messages.
messages.Para silenciar coches, marca solo Coches: To suppress cars, select only Cars and choose “Only when no selected category appears”. A car in any photo suppresses the entire email. If any photo is skipped, no absence notification is sent.
messages.Permitir usuario y contraseña SMTP sin c: Allow unencrypted SMTP username and password (trusted local network only)
messages.Petición de formulario no válida. Usa el: Invalid form request. Use the PiVigia panel.
messages.Petición no válida. Revisa los parámetro: Invalid request. Check the submitted parameters.
messages.PiVigia recibe las fotos en su servidor: PiVigia receives photos on its incoming SMTP server. It then uses another SMTP server, the outgoing one configured in Settings, to send notifications.
messages.Porcentaje de imagen que debe cambiar en: Percentage of the image that must change between samples. Increasing this reduces alerts for small changes.
messages.Puerto: el puerto de entrada publicado p: Port: the published incoming SMTP port; initially 2525. This is neither the panel port nor your email provider's port.
messages.Recepción, análisis y avisos, en un solo: Reception, analysis and notifications, all in one place.
messages.Rechaza imágenes más bajas que este valo: Rejects images shorter than this value. A 352 × 240 image fits the initial settings.
messages.Rechaza imágenes más estrechas que este: Rejects images narrower than this value; they are not enlarged to meet the limit.
messages.Revisa las IP de escucha, los puertos (1: Check the listening IPs, ports (1024–65535, different), allowed networks and both absolute TLS paths.
messages.Revisa las direcciones, contraseñas (mín: Check addresses, passwords (at least 8 characters), categories, limits, RTSP cameras and Telegram settings (token and chat IDs)
messages.Ruta absoluta a un archivo legible por e: Absolute path to a file readable by the PiVigia process. Do not paste the key contents here.
messages.Ruta absoluta, por ejemplo /ruta/pivigia: Absolute path, for example /path/pivigia.crt. Also configure the key or leave both empty.
messages.Se alcanzó el límite de imágenes por cor: The image limit per email was reached
messages.Se conservan metadatos según la retenció: Metadata is kept according to history retention. Preview images exist only in memory.
messages.Se usan los ajustes guardados: entre {mi: Saved settings apply: between {min_width} × {min_height} and {max_width} × {max_height} pixels; maximum {size} MB. Select a mailbox to check its categories, confidence and destinations.
Seconds between analyses of this camera. Increasing this reduces inference work.
messages.Servidor SMTP: la IP del equipo que ejec: SMTP server: the IP of the device running PiVigia, for example your Raspberry Pi's IP. Do not include http:// or the port in this field.
messages.Servidor y puertos · entrada de cámaras: Server and ports · camera input and panel access
messages.Si estás en la dirección directa de PiVi: If you are at PiVigia's direct address, return to Home Assistant to use your session. Do not enter your Home Assistant password here.
messages.Si la cámara no admite STARTTLS, permite: If the camera does not support STARTTLS, allow its exact IP without authentication or explicitly enable unencrypted authentication on a trusted network.
messages.Sin detecciones de las categorías selecc: No detections in the selected categories (forwarding all messages).
messages.Solo análisis local. No se ha enviado co: Local analysis only. No email or Telegram notification was sent and the image was not saved.
messages.Solo se envían imágenes a Telegram si lo: Images are sent to Telegram only if you enable it and configure a chat in the mailbox. Use email, Telegram or both. Each photo includes its detections and percentages.
messages.Solo se pueden reintentar mensajes falli: Only retained failed messages can be retried
messages.Solo si no aparece ninguna categoría mar: Only when no selected category appears
messages.Tamaño del archivo de cada imagen: 5 000: File size of each image: 5,000,000 bytes is approximately 5 MB.
messages.Telegram denegó el envío; inicia el bot: Telegram denied delivery; start the bot or check its chat permissions
messages.Telegram no confirmó la entrega de la im: Telegram did not confirm image delivery
messages.Telegram no confirmó la entrega del mens: Telegram did not confirm message delivery
messages.Telegram no pudo completar la petición: Telegram could not complete the request
messages.Telegram rechazó el chat o la imagen; re: Telegram rejected the chat or image; check the ID and bot permissions
messages.Telegram solicita esperar antes de reint: Telegram requires a delay before retrying
messages.Tu acceso es de solo consulta. Esta oper: Your access is read-only. This operation requires a PiVigia administrator.
messages.Un valor mayor exige más seguridad al de: A higher value requires more confidence from the detector and may miss people or objects that are hard to see.
messages.Una vista de tus cámaras y sus últimas d: A view of your cameras and their latest detections.
messages.Usa rutas absolutas para el certificado: Use absolute paths for the certificate and its key
messages.Usuario autorizado por tu proveedor; sue: Username authorized by your provider; usually your full email address.
messages.Usuario y destinatario: la dirección com: Username and recipient: the full address of the mailbox you created in PiVigia. Password: that mailbox's password.
messages.Ya hay una descarga en curso. Espera o c: A download is already in progress. Wait or cancel it.
messages.Ya hay una prueba en curso. Espera a que: A test is already running. Wait for it to finish.
messages.YunoHost gestiona HTTPS, los puertos asi: YunoHost manages HTTPS, assigned ports and STARTTLS. Check effective ports here and the YunoHost installation instructions.
messages.en Buzones y reglas, define dónde recibe: in Mailboxes and rules, define where PiVigia receives photos and who receives alerts.
messages.en Configuración, indica el servidor que: in Settings, enter the server that will send your email notifications, or enable Telegram.
messages.en Pruebas, envía un correo de prueba o: in Tests, send a test email or analyze an image without sending notifications.
messages.en la barra lateral o desde el complemen: from the sidebar or the add-on. Your user account is used there without another password.
messages.usa la IP de PiVigia y el puerto SMTP de: use PiVigia's IP and incoming SMTP port. You can check ports in Server and ports.
messages.usando la configuración que ya has guard: using your saved settings. A real email will be sent only to the recipient entered here. You do not need a camera or a detection.
messages.«Usar para correo y cámaras» cambia el d: “Use for email and cameras” changes the regular detector; the image test lets you choose another without changing it.
messages.¿Eliminar este modelo descargado? Podrás: Delete this downloaded model? You can download it again. Settings and photos will not be deleted.
messages.¿Qué debo poner en mi cámara?: What should I enter on my camera?
messages.Últimos correos recibidos y resultados d: Latest received emails and analysis and delivery results

user.title: Connect PiVigia
user.description: Install and start the PiVigia add-on or server first. Enter its full URL including the panel port, for example http://192.0.2.101:8099. Use the PiVigia panel token, not your Home Assistant password.

reconfigure.title: Change PiVigia connection
reconfigure.description: Update the panel IP, hostname or port. Leave the token empty to keep the saved one. The connection will be checked before saving.

reauth_confirm.title: Update PiVigia token
reauth_confirm.description: PiVigia rejected the saved token. Enter the current panel token and check the URL.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect. Check that PiVigia is running and the IP and port are accessible from Home Assistant.
error.invalid_auth: PiVigia rejected the token. Use the panel token, with at least 16 characters.
error.invalid_url: Enter a valid HTTP or HTTPS URL without username, password, parameters or fragment. The response must be from PiVigia.

abort.already_configured: This PiVigia server is already configured.

language.name: Service language (optional)
language.description: Language code: es (Spanish) or en (English). Leave empty to use the language saved in the panel. Setting it here fixes the language of logs and notifications and locks that setting in the panel. Save and restart.

panel_login.name: Panel sign-in method
panel_login.description: both: Home Assistant users through its interface and token for direct access. homeassistant: Home Assistant sessions only in the panel; the token still works for the status sensor. token: always requires the token. Save and restart.

admin_token.name: PiVigia panel token
admin_token.description: Choose at least 16 random characters. Use it to sign in to the panel; this is not your Home Assistant password.

trusted_networks.name: Cameras allowed without an SMTP username or password
trusted_networks.description: Optional. Comma-separated IPs or networks, for example 192.0.2.50/32. Leave empty to require authentication. Do not allow the entire network if only one camera needs access.

allow_plain_auth.name: Allow unencrypted SMTP authentication
allow_plain_auth.description: Enable only for cameras without STARTTLS support on a trusted local network. This does not configure outgoing email security.

tls_cert.name: Incoming STARTTLS certificate
tls_cert.description: Optional. Path to the certificate mounted in /ssl, for example /ssl/pivigia.crt. If you do not use STARTTLS, leave both certificate and key empty. To authenticate cameras without TLS, enable unencrypted SMTP authentication on a trusted local network.

tls_key.name: Incoming STARTTLS private key
tls_key.description: Optional. Path to the key in /ssl, for example /ssl/pivigia.key. Set both paths for STARTTLS or leave both empty. The camera must trust the certificate.

network.2525/tcp: SMTP port for receiving photos from your cameras. Change the Home Assistant access port here.
network.8099/tcp: Port for direct token access and sensors. Open Web UI uses Home Assistant Ingress and does not depend on this published port.
